item.title: Street level or corporate giant? Sneak Energy takes on the Man Without Fear
item.description: Sneak Energy joins forces with Marvel for a Daredevil Born Again season 2 collaboration. We investigate if the brand has traded its street level roots for an Avengers level corporate suit.

item.title: The Campaign Sleeve: Can $270 leather turn any tabletop game into a luxury experience?
item.description: Saiko Leathers launches a handcrafted journal sleeve for roleplaying games aimed at the bespoke luxury market.

item.title: The ADA irony: Niantic Spatial pivots Ingress toward high-stakes real-world intelligence
item.description: Niantic Spatial suspends Ingress mapping as it pivots toward high-stakes geospatial AI. Is the game’s original purpose as a data-harvesting engine for the "Real World AI" race finally being revealed?

item.title: Check out the trailer for supernatural horror ‘Obsession’
item.description: We all want to be loved, and have even probably wished for it to happen with someone we have feelings for... but never quite in this way. Focus Features has just dropped an insanely heavy first trailer for supernatural horror movie Obsession

item.title: Age of Ambition: Forward-Facing Fantasy in a Changing World
item.description: Leave the Dark Ages behind. The Age of Ambition RPG bundle offers a tabletop fantasy world of gunpowder, clockwork, and political upheaval. Get the core rules and 19 supplements for just $9.95.

item.title: Why these new Dungeons and Dragons numbered rings aim to kill encounter clutter
item.description: Wasted Wizard Games expands its stacking accessory range with numbered rings for Dungeons and Dragons, designed to track initiative and manage hordes in Tbilisi-born style.

item.title: Hearts Of Ravensdale: Why Cooking Is The New Combat In Son Of Oak’s Latest Release
item.description: Son of Oak launches Hearts of Ravensdale, the first setting book for Legend In The Mist, bringing rustic fantasy and the heroism of the hearth to the tabletop.

item.title: Godzilla: The Roleplaying Game brings card-based kaiju battles to the tabletop
item.description: IDW Games brings the King of the Monsters to your tabletop. Godzilla The Roleplaying Game uses a unique card based system to simulate desperate cinematic kaiju survival.

item.title: Geekify claims Neopets ‘stonewalled’ development before roleplaying game termination
item.description: 7,610 backers are left in limbo as the Neopets tabletop roleplaying game is cancelled. Geekify Inc alleges they were stonewalled by the licensor as the 427,000 dollar project collapses.

item.title: From Sword World to En-nichi: How Mugen Gaming is bridging the gap between Japanese indies and Western tables
item.description: The Japanese festival board game En-nichi is coming to Kickstarter in English. Can Kansas City publishers Mugen Gaming and Vala Foundry translate its "cosy" matsuri charm while maintaining authentic production standards?
